chinese_title: 艾米利亚诺·马丁内斯：守住时间的男孩
foreign_title: Dibu Martínez: El pibe que ataja el tiempo
aka: Emi Martínez: El niño que detiene el tiempo
Emi Martínez: The Kid Who Stops Time
description: we’ll premiere Emi Martínez: The Kid Who Stops Time, written by Hernán Casciari and illustrated by Liniers. Directed by Gustavo Cova, the film blends archived testimonial footage with animation to trace the story of Dibu Martínez, the boy who dreamed of the goal and became one of the greatest heroes of the Argentinian selection.
